summary: Reverified the 31 requested estimates against the supplied PDF and extraction rules. Read the entire markdown conversion, including references and the publisher page; extracted the text of every cited PDF page (2, 3, 7, and 8), checked the definitions on page 1, and inspected Figure 2 directly. Recorded coefficients, p-values, percentage effects, the printed arm mean, and analysis counts match the paper and the specified outcomes and arms. Coding is consistent with the codebook. Evaluator clustering is explicitly recorded as such, with the limitation that it does not account for repeated ratings of randomized writers. The 3519 ratings are the full regression analysis count, as documented in the extraction. Unprinted statistics and participant counts remain null. No missing in-scope outcome or reported contrast was identified in the supplied article. The separate Supplementary Materials are not included in either the supplied PDF or markdown, and no matching local supplement was found; supplement-only results could not be verified.
